extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying for ARC Discovery Projects (Australia); research teams preparing EOIs and full proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation criteria and process for ARC Discovery Projects (two-stage: EOI then full proposal), specifying weighting and sub-criteria for Project Quality, Investigator capability, and Feasibility/Benefit, plus career-stage adjustments and scheme objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: EOI: Investigator(s)/Capability (30%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Expression of Interest (EOI) stage criterion weighted at 30% for Investigator(s)/Capability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EOIs are assessed by three ARC College of Expert members; following moderation, highly-ranked projects are invited to submit a full proposal. Weighting: 30% of EOI score.

rubrics_metrics.name: EOI: Project Quality and Innovation (70%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Expression of Interest (EOI) stage criterion weighted at 70% for Project Quality and Innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EOIs are assessed by three ARC College of Expert members; following moderation, highly-ranked projects are invited to submit a full proposal. Weighting: 70% of EOI score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Quality and Innovation (40%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full proposal criterion (40%): assesses the quality, significance and innovativeness of the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considerations include: significance and innovation; likelihood of producing innovative and internationally competitive research; sound conceptual framework; methodological rigor; position relative to international state of the art. Weighting: 40% of full proposal score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigator(s)/Capability (30%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full proposal criterion (30%): assesses the capacity and track record of the investigator/team to undertake the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considerations include: capacity of the investigator/team to undertake the proposed research; track record relative to opportunities; demonstrated ability to attract HDR candidates; demonstrated ability to lead/train others; past contributions to advancement of the field. Weighting: 30% of full proposal score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feasibility and Benefit (30%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full proposal criterion (30%): assesses feasibility of the project and the benefits likely to accrue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considerations include: sound feasibility, including budget justification; project timeframes; adequacy of facilities and infrastructure; plans to disseminate research outcomes; national benefit. Weighting: 30% of full proposal score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Stage and Disruption Adjustments (assessment modifier)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjustments applied within the Investigator(s)/Capability assessment to account for career stage and disruptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment includes consideration of opportunities the researcher has had to build their research profile; early-career researchers receive appropriate consideration; researchers with interrupted research careers receive appropriate consideration; career disruptions can be explained in the application. Use these considerations when judging track record relative to opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheme Objectives (context for assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level objectives that the Discovery Projects scheme is intended to support and that inform assessment priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objectives: support excellent basic and applied research and research training by individuals and teams; support national and international research collaboration; enhance the scale and focus of research in Australian Government priority areas. These objectives inform the funding priorities though not expressed as discrete scored subcriteria beyond the formal criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Excellence in Research for Australia (ERA) assessments (contextual note)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement on how ERA assessments relate to individual grant scoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ERA assessments inform the broader research evaluation context but are not directly used for individual grant scoring. Consider ERA as background context rather than a direct scoring input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related ARC Schemes (comparative context)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other ARC schemes have similar criteria with scheme-specific variations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include DECRA (Discovery Early Career Researcher Award), Future Fellowships (mid-career), Laureate Fellowships (top tier), Linkage Projects (industry collaboration), LIEF (infrastructure). Applicants should consult scheme-specific guidance for variations in criteria, weighting, or eligibility.
